extracted.intended_audience: patent examiners and patent prosecutors (attorneys/agents) preparing or evaluating enablement
extracted.subtask_description: Applying the Wands factors (per MPEP 2164.01(a)) to determine whether a patent disclosure requires undue experimentation and thus fails the enablement requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Breadth of the claims
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as factor (A) in MPEP 2164.01(a) / In re Wands. A broader claim scope can increase the risk that the disclosure does not enable the full claimed scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nature of the invention
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as factor (B) in MPEP 2164.01(a) / In re Wands. The character and complexity of the invention affects how much detail is needed in the disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: State of the prior art
rubrics_metrics.description: The state of the prior art.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as factor (C) in MPEP 2164.01(a) / In re Wands. The existing knowledge in the field can reduce or increase the amount of disclosure or experimentation necessary for enablement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Level of ordinary skill in the art
rubrics_metrics.description: The level of one of ordinary skill.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as factor (D) in MPEP 2164.01(a) / In re Wands. Higher skill levels in the relevant art may mean less detailed disclosure is required for enablement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Level of predictability in the art
rubrics_metrics.description: The level of predictability in the art.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as factor (E) in MPEP 2164.01(a) / In re Wands. More predictable arts require less experimentation by a skilled person to practice the invention; unpredictable arts may need more disclosure or examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amount of direction provided by the inventor
rubrics_metrics.description: The amount of direction provided by the inventor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as factor (F) in MPEP 2164.01(a) / In re Wands. The degree of guidance, instructions, or steps disclosed affects whether undue experimentation would be required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Existence of working examples
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as factor (G) in MPEP 2164.01(a) / In re Wands. Presence of concrete working examples can support enablement; absence may weigh against enablement depending on other factors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quantity of experimentation needed
rubrics_metrics.description: The quantity of experimentation needed to make or use the invention based on the content of the disclosure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as factor (H) in MPEP 2164.01(a) / In re Wands. Evaluate how much trial-and-error or routine experimentation would be required from the disclosure to practice the full scope of the claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Holistic consideration of all Wands factors
rubrics_metrics.description: It is improper to conclude that a disclosure is not enabling based on an analysis of only one of the above factors while ignoring one or more of the others.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Per MPEP 2164.01(a), all Wands factors must be considered together when evaluating enablement; an examiner should not rely solely on a single factor. See related MPEP guidance (e.g., 'Examiner Must Consider All Enablement Evidence', 'Enablement Must Be Demonstrated Without Undue Experimentation', and topic-specific FAQs such as antibody-production examples) for application notes and examples.
